investigation_notes.Description: An unusually high volume of SharePoint file downloads (2100 files) was observed for Kevin Smit, far above his 24-hour baseline. The activity originated from a Tor exit, used an automated Python-urllib/3.12 client, and targeted production assets including backups, encryption keys, and a database export. Given the junior intern role, late local-hours in Vienna, and access to highly sensitive data through automated means, this appears to be a strong indication of potential data exfiltration and warrants high-priority escalation.
